title: Microsoft Teams: organisers choose who controls production tools in meetings with presenters and webinars
notes: claim 59: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
claim 60: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, default, qualified town hall control path and licensing statements are supported. The impact rationale overstates who sees the new meeting option: Microsoft identifies production staff as affected, but does not say they see the dropdown or establish that all other users do not.

claims.claim: Microsoft Teams is adding a meeting option named Who has control of production tools.
claims.quote: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event.

claims.claim: The announced option is for meetings with presenters and webinars.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new meeting option for meetings with presenters and webinars that allows organizers to specify who has control of production tools during an event.

claims.claim: The documented town hall path is Teams: Calendar > town hall > View event > Manage event > Meeting options > Production tools > Who has control of production tools.

claims.quote: Searched: Teams onlineMeeting production tools control Microsoft Graph PowerShell; read town hall Support article, Graph onlineMeeting beta and virtualEventSettings beta, and searched Teams meeting/events policy references. No production-control selection API found.

claims.where: rationale: cost; front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The advanced event feature category includes production controls.
claims.quote: They include the foundational capabilities plus advanced features such as event workflows, customization, production controls, monitoring, insights, and higher engagement event capacity.

claims.claim: Designated production staff will see the new option in meeting options.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams production tools organizer control default setting meeting options policy; Teams webinar production tools control organizer licensing. Read MC1443520 and town hall Support article: staff are affected, but only organisers are explicitly said to see the new option.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with: 'Medium. Organisers of meetings with presenters and webinars will see a new option in meeting options; Microsoft's notice also identifies designated production staff as affected.'

claims.claim: Users other than organisers and designated production staff will not see the new option.
